features: ONVIF Profile S and ONVIF Profile G
Maximum frame rate 1920 fps across all channels; single channel up to 1080p 60 fps recording
ARM Cortex CA53 quad-core CPU; embedded Linux kernel 4.19
Metadata recording: POS, RFID and PIN controller, barcode scanner, GPS, LPR, AI camera, IVS camera
RS-485 keyboard controller port; USB to RS-232 metadata input
P2P app connection by QR code / UID
AI camera object recognition (person, car, tripwire); 16 AI cameras supported by default
notes: Product page gives maximum network throughput as 300 Mbps, or 160 Mbps with RAID enabled; the datasheet gives 300 Mbps with no RAID figure.
Power consumption is stated as at most 16 W, without HDD and cameras.
Two-way audio is stated for network cameras; audio input is 64 channels from network cameras.
Internal HDD support is stated as up to 16 TB without saying whether this is per drive; per-bay capacity left out.
